verdict.rationale: The Admin SDK Directory API documents a REST endpoint that returns a paginated list of users (docs-5), and its guides cover creating and managing users (docs-22). The Cloud Identity API is documented for provisioning identity resources, including creating dynamic groups (docs-7, docs-30). Group coverage is thin, and nothing documents API-level app assignment, query filtering, or the auth model. Missing for 10: documented REST endpoints for app assignments, explicit group CRUD/membership reference, filtering/query parameters, clear auth/scopes documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
